title: Medication refill countdown board
summary: A non-dosing medicine continuity board that shows how many days remain, who owns each medicine, pharmacy options, and when to escalate before supply runs out.
content: Core sequence: 1) List medicine name, owner, days remaining, storage limit, prescriber, and usual pharmacy without changing doses. 2) Mark a refill warning before the final week or earlier if travel, islands, weather, or closures are likely. 3) Keep controlled, refrigerated, and life-critical medicines in separate clearly protected lines. 4) Escalate through pharmacy, prescriber, clinic, family, or emergency services before the last dose is reached.
